<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#F7F7FB">
<!-- Title --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvOrderTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="20dp" android:layout_marginTop="20dp" android:text="Orders" android:textColor="@android:color/black" android:textSize="22sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<!-- Subtitle --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvOrderSubtitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:text="View your past purchases" android:textColor="#9E9E9E" android:textSize="11sp" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@id/tvOrderTitle" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvOrderTitle" />
<!-- Empty state --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/layoutEmptyOrder" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:gravity="center" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvOrderSubtitle" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/imgEmptyOrder" android:layout_width="120dp" android:layout_height="120dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_no_order" android:contentDescription="No order icon" app:tint="#9E9E9E" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="20dp" android:text="There are no order yet" android:textColor="@android:color/black" android:textSize="18sp" /> </LinearLayout>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
